import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
arm_length = 80      # 臂长 (mm)
arm_height = 60      # 臂高 (mm)
thickness = 5        # 板厚 (mm)
hole_diameter = 5    # 安装孔直径 (mm)
edge_distance = 15   # 孔距边缘 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
# 竖直臂
vertical = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .box(arm_length, arm_height, thickness)
    .translate((0, -thickness / 2, arm_height / 2))
)

# 水平底座
horizontal = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(arm_length, arm_height, thickness)
    .translate((0, arm_height / 2 - thickness / 2, thickness / 2))
)

# 合并
result = horizontal.union(vertical)

# 底座安装孔
result = (
    result
    .faces("<Z").workplane()
    .center(0, edge_distance)
    .rect(arm_length - 2 * edge_distance, 0, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(hole_diameter)
)

show_object(result)
